purpose: Validate the frozen Stage 6-1 Hero composition against a deterministic representative fixture set before broader Hero-page admission work. This stage is QA only and does not become a new semantic producer.

fixtureFamilies.requirement: A non-COLLAB base SSR without released SP, selected closest to the median Stage-4 branch count of the eligible population.

A non-COLLAB Hero with the maximum Stage-4 branch count among currently unused candidates. This covers the multi-branch structural QA target only; release chronology is not asserted because no release-order source is joined in Stage 6-2.
An R or SR Hero maximizing the number and aggregate cross-Hero frequency of Stage-4 job display names shared with other Heroes.
A Hero whose frozen Stage 5-4 SP status is RELEASED.
A Hero whose frozen Stage 5-5 base rarity label is LLR.
A Hero whose frozen Stage 5-5 origin category is COLLAB.
Canonical heroId 1 (Matthew/매튜), explicitly retained as the known multi-branch structural exception fixture.

selectionPolicy.sourceOnly: Fixture traits are selected only from already-frozen Stage 4/5 outputs. Names are display evidence and are never join keys.
selectionPolicy.distinctness: Use distinct heroIds across fixture families whenever an eligible candidate exists.
selectionPolicy.tieBreak: After family-specific scores, choose the lowest canonical heroId for deterministic output.
selectionPolicy.releaseChronology: Stage 6-2 does not infer old/new release age from heroId, names, production title, artwork, or any other proxy.

commonQa: Stage 6-1 must be PASS / COMPLETE and its frozen validation must have zero hard errors.
Every selected Stage 6-1 sourceIndexes locator must resolve to the same canonical heroId in Stage 4, Stage 5-1, Stage 5-2, Stage 5-4 and Stage 5-5.
Stage 6-1 soldiersKey must resolve the same Hero in Stage 5-3 byHeroId.
Stage 6-1 snapshot values for exclusive-equipment status/id, central-discipline status, Soldier count and SP status must match the frozen source blocks exactly.
Hero identity display values must agree across frozen sources whenever the source carries that value.
Stage-4 job-tree connection IDs must be unique; primary and all branch connection IDs must resolve within that Hero's frozen connection set.
Stage 5-2 feature states must be RELEASED or NOT_RELEASED; released exclusive equipment must carry an integer equipmentId and, when ownerHeroId is present, it must equal the fixture heroId.
Stage 5-3 Soldier IDs must be unique per Hero and every referenced Soldier must exist in soldiersById.
Stage 5-4 SP status must be RELEASED or NOT_RELEASED.
Stage 5-5 base rarity, origin category, factions, skins and artwork source path must remain structurally valid.

multi-branch-structural: selected branchCount equals the maximum eligible non-COLLAB branchCount after prior distinct fixtures

forbiddenWork: Recalculate Hero stats, talent, job semantics, skill acquisition or awakening semantics.
Re-derive Hero-exclusive Equipment ownership or compete with Stage B.
Infer release age from heroId or other unsourced proxies.
Invent localization or browser asset URLs.
completion: Stage 6-2 is COMPLETE when all seven deterministic fixture families are represented, every fixture passes common and family-specific QA, no source locator or snapshot mismatch exists, and hardErrorCount is zero.
